Players Committee card image of [[Planetary Rings]] (first published image; no errata mark), printing: “Deploy on a battleground planet system. Adds one [Light Side] icon at your related Big One. If a sector was just drawn for asteroid destiny, cancel and redraw that destiny. Once per turn, may ▼ a sector to this system. [Immune to Alter.]” Uploaded unchanged.

Source: the Players Committee Holotable image set, file [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/1fa635b/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual13-Dark/Large/Planetary%20Rings.gif Images-HT/starwars/Virtual13-Dark/Large/Planetary Rings.gif] as of commit 1fa635b “virtual set 13 cards” (9 November 2020).
